title: STM32 HAL Codes - Microcontroller Programming
description: Collection of STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller projects using STM32 HAL library. Developed with STM32CubeMX for configuration and code generation, compiled in KEIL UVISION5 IDE, and programmed via ST-LINK debugger. Covers GPIO, timers, interrupts, UART, and peripheral control on ARM Cortex-M3 architecture.
